# TitanDevDataDynamics — AI Capabilities & System Architecture

> TitanDevDataDynamics is a specialized software engineering consultancy building Enterprise AI Agents, On-Premise LLM Solutions, Computer Vision Systems (YOLO11, SAM 2), Real-Time Data Lakehouses (Apache Iceberg, Kafka), and Cloud-Native Microservices (Kubernetes, Istio, eBPF).

## Core Offerings

- **Enterprise AI Agents & RAG:** Context Engineering, Hybrid Retrieval (Vector + BM25), RRF Reranking, Guardrails, LangGraph orchestration.
- **Computer Vision & Automated Inspection:** Sub-20ms visual defect detection with YOLO11, automated inventory counting with SAM 2.
- **On-Premise IA & Data Sovereignty:** Private LLM fine-tuning (Llama 3.3, Qwen 2.5), local hosting using vLLM / TensorRT-LLM, zero data leakage.
- **Real-Time Data Lakehouses:** Apache Iceberg table format, streaming ingestion with Kafka/Flink, sub-second analytical queries via Trino/ClickHouse.
- **Cloud-Native Microservices:** Event-driven architecture, Kubernetes, Istio service mesh, eBPF observability.

## API Integration & Demos

- Backend Engine: Python FastAPI serving `/api/v1/roi/calculate` and `/api/v1/demos/vision`.
- Security & Compliance: ISO 27001 readiness, GDPR / HIPAA compliant architectures.
